newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X shares resume trading on TSE.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X shares resume trading on TSE.

text.p: Shares in Bre-X Minerals Ltd resumed trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange at 1130 EDT/1530 GMT on Tuesday after being halted for a little more than an hour due to systems problems, the TSE said.
"Basically, the record volumes were overwhelming the communications lines so we closed trading in the stock to handle the volume," said TSE spokesman Steve Kee.

Bre-X was down 3.16 to 0.07 with a whopping 39.4 million shares changing hands. With the session barely under way, Bre-X's volume already topped the all-time daily volume record for a single stock on the TSE.
On April 16, 1996, Black Swan Gold Mines Ltd traded 38.5 million shares.
